assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a new standalone vertical 2:3 comic-book illustration of one radiant yellow faceted cosmic gemstone. An elongated irregular crystal, brilliant white core, sharp yellow-gold angular facets, pale energy filaments and small sparks. Suspended in deep indigo starry space. The complete gem silhouette centered in the upper two thirds with generous room around it; lower quarter mostly dark cosmic atmosphere for later Thai text. Rich saturated colors, crisp ink contours, beautiful painted highlights, premium collectible card illustration. Full bleed. No card frame, no text boxes, no lettering, no numbers, no symbols or logos. Artwork only.
